Game Overview

In Bunny Collect Eggs, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a charming adventure as a bunny collecting Easter eggs in this delightful platformer. Navigate vibrant levels, evade cunning foes, and leap to victory. With intuitive controls and strategic planning, gather eggs to advance while searching for the elusive special egg. It's a whimsical, egg-citing challenge!
